attestations.text: WANG Yin-chih 王引之 (T. 伯申, H. 曼卿), Apr. 19, 1766–1834, Dec. 24, official and scholar, eldest son of Wang Nien-sun [q. v.], was a native of Kao-yu, Kiangsu. After taking his chin-shih degree with high honors in 1799, he was appointed a compiler in the Hanlin Academy.
